verdict.rationale: Once enabled, Bugbot runs AI code review autonomously in the background on new PRs and every PR update, across GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps. Admins can shape this behavior with org-wide rules in Bugbot Automations, auto-learned rules, and natural-language effort policies. Community reports confirm it runs live in orgs, and one user's choice to turn off the automatic reviews shows they fire by default. missing for 10: automations beyond PR-review triggers (custom triggers, schedules or arbitrary tasks), and in-depth documentation of what Bugbot Automations can configure beyond rules.
